info.description: Internal-only runtime + knowledge surface. Bound to 127.0.0.1; only gateway_host calls it. All endpoints are mounted under /internal.
info.title: Agentic Agent Node — Runtime Host API

post.description: Validates the collection + form and binds the draft to the node wallet. Returns the stored draft + status.

requestBody.description: Collection address | Owner address | Agent name | Agent role | Token id this agent clones | Attributes as a JSON object string | Base image to frame

post.description: Uses the node's bootstrap wallet to mint (or create a mint proposal) and ENS-register the stored draft.
Resolves the agent identity, fetches OwnerOf(tokenId), compares to the supplied address. Used by gateway during /auth/verify.
Idempotent batch append to the local conversation transcript. Dedup by SHA-512 hash of (role, content, conversationId).

get.description: Returns the agent's collection address + tokenId + ENS name. 404 when no NFT has been minted yet.

post.description: Writes the `url` text record for the agent's NFT via AgentEnsRegistry. Requires the NFT to already exist.
